An Ordinance further
to amend the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th, October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.l(34)/2002, dated
9-10-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information: --
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Stamp (Fourth Sindh
Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
